paper.title_en: Analyzing Quasi-normal modes spectrum in asymptotically de Sitter black bounces and their optical appearance
paper.abstract_en: This work explores asymptotically de Sitter black-bounce spacetimes, obtained as a regular extension of the Schwarzschild-de Sitter geometry via the Simpson-Visser prescription. The resulting family of solutions provides a smooth interpolation between regular black holes, extremal configurations, and traversable wormholes within a single geometrical framework. In particular, we verify the regularity of the spacetime by showing that (some of) curvature invariants, including the Kretschmann and Ricci scalars, remain finite at the origin for any non-vanishing value of the regularization parameter $a$, ensuring geodesic completeness. An analysis of the effective stress-energy tensor reveals a violation of the null energy condition, which can be consistently interpreted in terms of a composite source involving a phantom scalar field coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics. Subsequently, we investigate the observational signatures of these geometries by studying: i) null geodesic propagation and ii) constructing the associated optical appearance. In particular, we determine the shadow radius and characterize the structure of photon rings through numerical ray-tracing procedure. Finally, we compute the spectrum of axial gravitational perturbations using a pseudospectral approach, obtaining the quasinormal mode frequencies and their overtones. Our results show a non-trivial interplay between the cosmological constant and the regularization scale $a$, which imprints itself on both the light-ring structure and the quasinormal spectrum. These features suggest potential observational discriminants that could distinguish these regular spacetimes from their singular counterparts in future gravitational-wave and high-resolution electromagnetic observations.

decision.title_zh: 分析渐近德西特黑洞弹跳中的准正则模谱及其光学外观
decision.abstract_zh: 这项工作探索了渐近德西特黑洞弹跳时空，这些时空是通过Simpson-Visser处方对Schwarzschild-de Sitter几何的正则扩展而获得的。所得解族在单一几何框架内提供了正则黑洞、极端构型和可穿越虫洞之间的平滑插值。特别地，我们通过证明（某些）曲率不变量（包括Kretschmann和Ricci标量）在原点处对任何非零正则化参数 $a$ 的值都保持有限，确保测地线完备性，从而验证了时空的正则性。对有效应力-能量张量的分析揭示了零能量条件的违反，这可以一致地解释为涉及phantom标量场与非线性电动力学耦合的复合源。随后，我们通过研究以下内容来探索这些几何的观测特征：i）零测地线传播和ii）构建相关的光学外观。特别地，我们确定了阴影半径并通过数值光线追踪程序刻画了光子环的结构。最后，我们使用伪谱方法计算了轴向引力扰动的谱，获得了准正则模频率及其泛音。我们的结果显示宇宙学常数与正则化尺度 $a$ 之间存在非平凡的相互作用，这种相互作用同时印刻在光环结构和准正则谱上。这些特征提示了潜在的观测判据，可以在未来的引力波和高分辨率电磁观测中将这些正则时空与其奇异对应物区分开来。
